moderation.playerNotFound: This player has never joined the network.

notes.title: Internal notes

activity.noData: No sessions recorded in this period.

connections.relatedAccounts: Other accounts on these IP addresses

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: Data minimisation for personal data collected by the plugins.
privacy.ipRetentionHint: Older IP addresses are removed from connection records and the audit log every hour. Approximate country and network are kept. Blacklist entries are not affected.
privacy.evidenceRetentionHint: Removed evidence stays available for investigations, then its content is deleted permanently. The history keeps that it existed.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.subtitle: Network-wide statistics collected by the Paper servers.
stats.noData: No statistics have been collected for this player yet.
stats.networkNoData: No statistics have been collected yet. Install the Paper plugin with statistics enabled.
stats.partial: Statistics are collected since {date}. Earlier activity is not included in this range.

anticheat.title: AntiCheat
anticheat.subtitle: Reports from AntiCheat integrations and the rules that decide punishments.
anticheat.enabledHint: When disabled, reports are still recorded but nothing is punished.
anticheat.collectEvidenceHint: Evidence text and details sent by integrations are stored with events and punishments.
anticheat.maxPerMinute: Max. automatic punishments per server and minute
anticheat.defaultRuleHint: Applies to automatic reports whose check has no rule. "Log only" is recommended.
anticheat.commandFallbackHint: Applies to explicit /anticheatban requests whose check has no rule.
anticheat.rulesHint: Checks are matched case-insensitively against the name the integration reports.
anticheat.examplesHint: Examples: Speed 30 days, Fly 14 days, KillAura permanent. Review them before saving.
anticheat.noRules: No rules yet. Reports are handled by the defaults above.
anticheat.saved: AntiCheat settings saved. They apply to the next report.
anticheat.readOnly: You can view the rules but need the anticheat.manage permission to change them.

inventory.noSnapshot: No snapshot has been recorded on this server yet. Snapshots are sent when the player joins or leaves a Paper server.
inventory.refreshHint: Only possible while the player is online on this server.
inventory.refreshRequested: Snapshot requested. It arrives within a few seconds.
inventory.offlineNotice: The player is not on this server. Changes are queued and applied safely when they next join it.
inventory.onlineNotice: The player is online on this server. Changes are applied within a few seconds.
inventory.pending: A change is waiting to be applied.
inventory.selectHint: Select a slot to inspect or edit it. Drag items to move or swap them.
inventory.name: Custom name
inventory.changes: {count, plural, =0 {No changes} one {# changed slot} other {# changed slots}}
inventory.reason: Reason (optional, stored in the audit log)
inventory.saved: Change queued. It is applied only if the affected slots are still unchanged in game.
inventory.readOnly: Viewing only. Editing requires the players.edit.inventory permission.
inventory.rollbackConfirm: Restore the slots of this change to their previous items? This is applied only if they are still unchanged in game.
inventory.invalidId: Use a namespaced ID such as minecraft:diamond_sword.
inventory.conflictHint: Nothing was changed: the inventory changed in game first.

errors.STALE_REVISION: The inventory changed meanwhile. The latest snapshot has been loaded; please redo your change.
errors.PENDING_EDIT: Another change is still waiting to be applied.
errors.STALE_SLOT: A slot changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
errors.PLAYER_NOT_ON_SERVER: The player is not online on this server.

integration.title: Add a server
integration.description: Configure the Velocity or Paper plugin, create a single-use registration token and download a ready-to-use configuration.
integration.nameHint: Letters, digits, "_", "." and "-" (2–64 characters). Shown in the dashboard.
integration.backendUrlHint: Address the Minecraft server uses to reach this dashboard, without a path.
integration.insecure: Plain HTTP to a public address: requests are signed but not encrypted. Use HTTPS or a private network address.
integration.languageHint: Language of in-game messages. Can be changed later under Plugin settings.
integration.punishmentsHint: Enforce network bans and mutes (works offline from a local cache).
integration.syncIntervalHint: Full list of connected players, repairs session state.
integration.collectIpsHint: IP addresses are personal data and only visible with the corresponding permission.
integration.integrationsHint: Comma-separated plugin names, e.g. Grim, Vulcan. Rules are configured on the AntiCheat page.
integration.maxReports: Max. reports per integration and minute
integration.managedHint: Plugin settings (language, messages, statistics, inventories) apply live without a restart.
integration.tokenExplanation: Creating a token adds it to the configuration. It is single-use, expires after a short time and is shown only here.

progress.title: Connecting "{name}"
progress.install: Install the plugin and copy the configuration to {path}, then start the server
progress.waitingRegistration: Waiting for the plugin to register…
progress.connected: Connected – the server is sending heartbeats
progress.expired: The token expired before the server registered. Add the server again to create a new token.

problems.backendUrl: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://.
problems.backendUrlPath: The URL must not contain a path, query or fragment.
problems.integrations: Use plugin names separated by commas.
problems.name: Use 2–64 letters, digits, "_", "." or "-".
problems.range: A value is outside its allowed range.

integration.pendingDescription: Tokens that have not been redeemed yet. Revoke tokens you no longer need.

pluginSettings.title: Plugin settings
pluginSettings.description: Pushed to all connected plugins with managed-settings=true. "Server setting" keeps each server’s own config.properties value.
pluginSettings.languageHint: Languages without a bundled plugin file use English plus your message overrides.
pluginSettings.localOnly: Backend URL, AntiCheat integrations, IP collection, intervals for heartbeats and proxy syncs, moderation switches and debug logging stay in each server’s config.properties and require a restart.
pluginSettings.messagesDescription: Override in-game texts such as ban screens, moderation notices and command responses per language.
pluginSettings.noBundled: There is no bundled plugin file for {locale}: English is shown as the base text.
pluginSettings.formatHint: MiniMessage formatting such as red or bold tags is allowed; click and insertion tags are not. Keep the placeholders of the original text (for example '{player}').

problems.unsafe-content: Click, insertion and data tags are not allowed.
problems.unknown-placeholder: Uses a placeholder the original text does not have.
problems.empty: The message must not be empty.

pluginSettings.invalidMessages: Some messages are invalid. Please check the highlighted entries.
pluginSettings.stale: Someone else changed these settings in the meantime.
pluginSettings.neverSaved: Not saved yet – all servers use their own configuration.
pluginSettings.saved: Saved. Servers apply the changes with their next heartbeat.
pluginSettings.appealUrlHint: Shown on ban screens. Leave empty to hide the appeal line.

presets.title: Punishment templates
presets.description: Predefined reasons and durations offered when issuing punishments in the dashboard.
presets.name: Name
presets.requireEvidenceHint: Flag active bans and mutes without evidence for review in the dashboard. Punishments stay in force; in-game bans can get evidence later.

languages.description: Enable languages, choose the default and import or export dashboard translations. Missing texts fall back to English.
languages.resetDescription: Imported texts are removed and the bundled translation is used again.
languages.deleteDescription: The language and its imported texts are removed. Users who selected it switch to the network default.
languages.name: Name
languages.created: Language added. Import a translation and enable it.
languages.workflow: To translate: export English (en-US), translate the values (keep the keys and the placeholders in curly braces), import the file into the new language and enable it.
languages.imported: {count, plural, =0 {Translation imported. It is complete.} one {Translation imported. # text is missing and uses English.} other {Translation imported. # texts are missing and use English.}}
languages.invalidJson: The file is not valid JSON.

errors.DURATION_ALREADY_ELAPSED: This duration has already elapsed since the punishment was created. Choose a longer one.

updates.title: Updates
updates.description: Installed versions, the newest Nexora release and the plugins of your servers. Nexora never installs updates automatically.
updates.notificationText: A new version of Nexora is available.
updates.checkedRecently: Checked less than a minute ago – showing the cached result.
updates.tooManyChecks: Too many checks. Try again in a minute.
updates.manualDisabled: Manual checks are disabled in the update settings.
updates.disabledHint: Update checks are disabled. The information below may be out of date.

updates.lastKnown: Showing the last verified result from {time}.
updates.retryAt: GitHub allows the next request after {time}; Nexora retries automatically then.

errors.TIMEOUT: GitHub did not answer in time.

warnings.UPGRADE_PATH: This release requires version {version} or newer to upgrade directly. Update to {version} first (read the release notes).
warnings.PLUGIN_INCOMPATIBLE: Version mismatch: the plugin on {server} ({version}) does not match this backend. Install the plugin of the same release.
warnings.PLUGIN_VERSION_UNKNOWN: {server} has not reported a plugin version yet.

updates.channelHint: Pre-releases are test versions; only use them on test networks.
updates.pluginsDescription: Plugin version reported by each server with its heartbeat.
updates.assetMissing: Not every plugin file is attached to this release; download it from the release page.
updates.outdatedPlugins: {count, plural, one {# server runs an outdated plugin} other {# servers run outdated plugins}} (latest release: {version}).
updates.settingsDescription: How Nexora looks for new releases and who is notified.
updates.settingsReadOnly: Only users with permission to manage updates can change these settings.
updates.noAutoInstall: Nexora only reads release information from GitHub. Nothing is downloaded, installed or replaced automatically.

settings.enabledHint: Ask GitHub for new releases regularly (read-only, no account needed).
settings.manualChecksHint: Allow "Check for updates" in addition to the schedule.
settings.dashboardNotificationsHint: Notify users with the updates.notify permission in the dashboard.
settings.minecraftNotificationsHint: Notify staff with networkmanager.update.notify when they join the network.
settings.cooldownHint: At most one in-game notification per staff member in this period.

updates.noSuccessYet: No release information has been retrieved yet, so the installed version cannot be verified.
updates.rateLimitedWait: GitHub rate limit reached. Nexora retries automatically after {time}.
updates.rateLimitHint: Without a token, GitHub allows 60 requests per hour per public IP address, shared with every other program on the same network. Set GITHUB_TOKEN on the backend (a token without any permissions is enough) to raise the limit to 5000 per hour.
updates.tokenInvalidHint: GitHub rejected the configured GITHUB_TOKEN. Replace or remove it in the backend environment and restart the backend.
updates.checkInProgress: Another check is running right now – showing its result.

reasons.title: Punishment reasons
reasons.description: Numbered ban, mute, kick and warning reasons with duration and permission. Staff use them in-game (/ban Steve 1) and in the dashboard.
reasons.duplicated: Copy created (disabled until you enable it).
reasons.idHint: Reason IDs are separate per category (ban reason 1 ≠ mute reason 1) and are not punishment IDs. Archived reasons keep their ID so it is never reused.
reasons.name: Name
reasons.playerReasonHint: Shown to the player (ban screen, chat) and stored on the punishment.
reasons.permissionHint: Leave empty for {permission}. The same permission is checked in-game (LuckPerms) and in the dashboard.
reasons.snapshotHint: Changes only affect new punishments. Issued punishments keep the reason and duration they were created with.
reasons.modeDescription: How staff specify reasons – network-wide, for all proxies, servers, staff members and the dashboard.
reasons.modeSaved: Command mode saved. All servers apply it within a few seconds.
reasons.modeGlobal: This is one setting for the whole network, not a personal preference. Only users who may manage punishment reasons can change it.

modeHints.HYBRID: Reason IDs and typed reasons. Typed reasons need nexora.punishment.custom.
modeHints.PRESET_ONLY: Only configured reasons with their duration. Typed reasons are rejected.
modeHints.FREE_TEXT: Only typed reasons (behaviour before reason presets). Reason IDs are disabled.

reasons.noneUsable: You may not use any configured reason.
reasons.presetOnlyHint: The network uses reason IDs only.
reasons.hybridHint: Choose a configured reason or type your own.
reasons.typedNotAllowed: You may only use configured reasons.

blocked.STALE_PERMISSIONS: Your Minecraft permissions have not been synchronised recently. Join the network or ask an administrator to recheck them.
blocked.NO_PERMISSION_DATA: No Minecraft permissions have been synchronised for your linked account yet.

errors.DUPLICATE_PRESET_ID: This reason ID is already used in this category (archived reasons keep their ID).
errors.STALE_PRESET: Someone else changed this reason in the meantime. Close the editor and try again.
errors.PRESETS_DISABLED: Reason IDs are disabled: the command mode only allows typed reasons.
errors.PRESET_REQUIRED: The command mode only allows reason IDs. Choose a reason.
errors.PRESET_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to use this reason.
errors.CUSTOM_REASON_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to use custom reasons.
errors.DURATION_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change the duration of a reason.
errors.PERMANENT_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to make this reason permanent.

staff.minecraftAccountDescription: Link your Minecraft account to use your in-game permissions in the dashboard. Run /nexora link on the network to get a code.
staff.codeHint: From /nexora link in Minecraft. Valid for 5 minutes, usable once.
staff.luckPermsManagedHint: The moderation permissions of this account come from LuckPerms. Change them with LuckPerms (groups and permission nodes) – they cannot be edited here.
staff.unlinkDescription: The account keeps its dashboard role; LuckPerms permissions no longer apply.
staff.unlinkManagedDescription: This account is managed by LuckPerms: unlinking disables it and signs it out everywhere.

errors.INVALID_LINK_CODE: The code is invalid, expired or already used. Run /nexora link again.
errors.ALREADY_LINKED: This Minecraft account is already linked to a dashboard account.
errors.LINKING_DISABLED: Account linking is disabled on this network.
errors.REGISTRATION_DISABLED: Staff registration is disabled on this network.
errors.NOT_ELIGIBLE: Your Minecraft rank does not grant dashboard access.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again later.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: This email address is already in use.

luckperms.title: LuckPerms
luckperms.description: Use LuckPerms groups and permissions for staff: the same punishment permissions in-game and in the dashboard, account linking and automatic access management.
luckperms.installHint: Install LuckPerms on the Velocity proxy (with the Nexora plugin 1.3 or newer). The plugin detects it automatically and starts synchronising.

modeHints.DISABLED: Only Nexora's own roles and permissions.
modeHints.HYBRID: Dashboard roles stay as assigned. Linked staff use their LuckPerms permissions for punishment reasons.
modeHints.MANAGED: Additionally, accounts created by linking get their role from the group mapping and lose access when no eligible group remains.

luckperms.linkingEnabledHint: Staff can link their Minecraft account with /nexora link.
luckperms.registrationHint: Eligible staff can create a dashboard account with a link code (role from the group mapping).
luckperms.staleAfterHint: Older LuckPerms data blocks sensitive actions until it is refreshed.
luckperms.ownerProtected: The protected Owner account never depends on LuckPerms: no group can grant or remove it, and it keeps working during LuckPerms or proxy outages.
luckperms.mappingDescription: Which LuckPerms groups give which dashboard role. The highest priority wins; a denied group removes dashboard access.
luckperms.mappingHint: Inherited groups count. The Owner role cannot be mapped. Changes apply to LuckPerms-managed accounts right away.

register.title: Staff registration
register.description: Create your dashboard account with a code from /nexora link.
register.codeHint: Run /nexora link on the network. The code is valid for 5 minutes.
register.disabled: Staff registration is not enabled on this network. Ask an administrator.
register.fromLogin: Staff member without an account? Register with /nexora link
register.done: Account created. You can sign in now.

clients.unavailable: Client detection is turned off: new connections show Unknown.
clients.rawBrandHint: Sent by the client itself; not verified.

clientDetection.title: Client detection
clientDetection.description: Which Minecraft client players use, from the brand their client reports to the proxy. Changes reach the proxy within one heartbeat.
clientDetection.enabledHint: Record the client brand of new connections. Existing history is kept.
clientDetection.noriskHint: When the official NoRisk Client server API plugin is installed on the proxy, ask it whether a player uses NoRisk Client. Without that plugin this has no effect.
clientDetection.showRawBrand: Show the raw client brand to all staff
clientDetection.showRawBrandHint: Administrators who manage servers always see it. Useful for troubleshooting.
clientDetection.debugHint: Extra proxy and backend log lines for every detection step (no IP addresses). Turn off when done.
clientDetection.selfReported: Client brands are reported by the client itself and can be changed by the player. They identify the client for display, not for security decisions.

rankDisplay.title: Rank display
rankDisplay.description: How LuckPerms groups appear in the dashboard. Appearance only: permissions and access are not affected.
rankDisplay.none: No custom rank displays yet. Ranks use the LuckPerms prefix or display name.
rankDisplay.select: Choose a group, or enter a LuckPerms group name to configure a custom rank.

sourceHint.CUSTOM: Shows the display name below instead of the LuckPerms text.
sourceHint.LUCKPERMS_PREFIX: Shows the formatted LuckPerms prefix, with your colours and icon.
sourceHint.LUCKPERMS_DISPLAY_NAME: Shows the formatted LuckPerms display name, with your colours and icon.
sourceHint.GROUP_NAME: Shows the readable group name, e.g. "Senior Mod".

rankDisplay.nameRequired: A custom rank needs a display name.
rankDisplay.iconTextHint: Unicode symbol or emoji shown before the name, e.g. ★.
rankDisplay.fallbackHint: Shown when the icon cannot be displayed, e.g. for resource-pack glyphs.
rankDisplay.iconHint: PNG, WebP, GIF or JPEG, at most {kb} KB. Shown at 14 px.
rankDisplay.saveFirst: Save the rank display first, then upload an icon.
rankDisplay.iconType: Icons must be PNG, WebP, GIF or JPEG images.
rankDisplay.iconTooLarge: Icons may be at most {kb} KB.
rankDisplay.glyphWarning: This icon uses a private-use character from a resource-pack font. Browsers cannot show it, so the fallback text or an uploaded icon is used instead.
rankDisplay.previewEmpty: Nothing to show: the selected source has no text for this group.
rankDisplay.noSample: No player of this group has been synchronised yet; the preview falls back to the group name.
rankDisplay.lowContrast: Low contrast ({ratio}:1). Choose colours with at least 4.5:1 so the rank stays readable.
rankDisplay.appearanceOnly: Only changes how the rank looks. Permissions still come from LuckPerms.
rankDisplay.removeDescription: The group then appears with its LuckPerms prefix or display name again.
